nodes.name: cmd_account_test.go
nodes.summary: Go test suite for the `pactify account` cobra subcommand — verifies that login/whoami/token are wired as its children and that `account login` fails closed when PACT_RELAY_URL is empty.

nodes.name: TestAccountCmdRegistered
nodes.summary: Asserts the `account` cobra subcommand is registered and that login/whoami/token are its children.

nodes.name: TestAccountLoginNoRelayErrors
nodes.summary: Drives `pactify account login` with PACT_RELAY_URL unset and asserts the emitted error mentions `no relay URL`.

nodes.name: cmd_agent_manifest_test.go
nodes.summary: Go tests for the `pactify agent-manifest` command — cover manifest validation, add/remove flow, and refusal of built-in kind names.

nodes.name: TestAgentManifestValidate
nodes.summary: Validates a minimal manifest prints OK and that an invalid manifest (no `kind`, no `runner`) produces an error from the cobra subcommand.

nodes.name: runManifest
nodes.summary: Test helper that executes the agent-manifest cobra command with the given args and returns its stdout or fails the test.

nodes.name: TestAgentManifestAddRemove
nodes.summary: Adds a manifest under PACTIFY_HOME, asserts the file is installed, refuses built-in kinds, then verifies remove deletes the manifest.

nodes.name: cmd_run_test.go
nodes.summary: Go tests for the `pactify run` command — verify required `--feature`/acting-seat gate, plan-summary rendering from a JSON plan, and yes/no confirm parsing.

nodes.name: TestRunRequiresFeature
nodes.summary: Asserts `pactify run` errors when `--feature` is omitted and the error mentions `--feature is required`.

nodes.name: TestRunRequiresActingSeat
nodes.summary: Asserts `pactify run` errors when PACT_AGENT_ID (the acting seat) is unset and the error mentions an acting seat.

nodes.name: TestPlanSummaryRendersTasks
nodes.summary: Writes a 2-task plan JSON into `.pact/plan-feat-x.json`, calls planSummary, and checks task count, ids, owner, reviewer, and deps render in the preview→confirm summary.

nodes.name: TestConfirmYesNo
nodes.summary: Exercises confirm reader across six input cases (y/yes/Y/n/empty/maybe) and asserts each maps to the right boolean and the prompt is printed.

nodes.name: cmd_version_test.go
nodes.summary: Go tests for the version-string builder — verify default dev identity and injected build-tag rendering.

nodes.name: TestVersionStringDefault
nodes.summary: Asserts versionString renders the dev identity as `pactify dev (none, unknown)`.

nodes.name: TestVersionStringInjected
nodes.summary: Asserts versionString includes the injected version (v0.3.0) and commit hash (abc1234).

nodes.name: cmd_version.go
nodes.summary: Cobra implementation of `pactify version` — prints the build identity line (version, commit, build date) to stdout.

nodes.name: log.jsonl
nodes.summary: Hand-authored pact-protocol event log (15 events) used by the dashboard showcase fixture — covers init/assign/join/checkpoint/accept/changes_requested across three seats (claude, opencode, gemini) and three features (relay, office-ui, f19).

nodes.name: layout.json
nodes.summary: Canvas-layout coordinates for the showcase dashboard — pins positions of seats (claude/opencode/gemini), features (relay, office-ui), and tasks (t1–t6) in the office view; ships alongside the pact log so dashboards render deterministically.

nodes.name: STATE.yml
nodes.summary: Projected state of the showcase pact log — 3 seats, 3 features, 9 tasks spanning every status (accepted/awaiting_review/in_progress/changes_requested/assigned) with explicit dep chains (t1→t2→t3, t4→{t5,t6}, t191→{t192,t193}).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the showcase dashboard fixture — explains the hand-authored log/state that seeds canvas/desks/ants/kanban/replay and the `pactify serve --project` workflow that consumes it without touching the real project registry.

nodes.name: plugin.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code plugin manifest declaring the pact plugin's metadata (name, description, version, author, repo, license) so the loader discovers and registers it.

nodes.name: .mcp.json
nodes.summary: MCP server configuration wiring the `pact` server to invoke `pactify mcp` as its command — exposes every protocol verb as an MCP tool inside Claude Code.

nodes.name: check-pactify.sh
nodes.summary: SessionStart hook shell script that checks for the `pactify` binary on PATH and prints an install hint when missing (deliberately never auto-installs).

nodes.name: hooks.json
nodes.summary: Claude plugin hook configuration registering check-pactify.sh to run on SessionStart so users get a hint when the pactify binary is missing.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: README for the pact Claude Code plugin — describes the bundled MCP server, install prerequisite (`pactify` on PATH), and explains the seat-baked double-wiring caveat.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Claude skill spec for pact-protocol coordination via the MCP tools — covers seat identity, role-specific job instructions (orchestrator/worker/reviewer), and the two protocol rules (no self-accept, no early merge).

nodes.name: accept.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for the `pact accept` verb — reviewer acceptance flips status to `accepted`, worker self-accept is rejected (rule 1), and `pact_changes` sends a task back to `changes_requested`.

nodes.name: agent_add.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for `pactify agent add` — verifies wiring of opencode/Claude-desktop/CODEX targets, error paths for unknown kind/missing flags, and the `--print` no-write guarantee.

nodes.name: assign.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for `pact assign` — verifies a task surfaces as `assigned` in STATE.yml, rejects owner == reviewer (rule 1), and fails closed without PACT_AGENT_ID.

nodes.name: checkpoint.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for `pact checkpoint` — verifies owner-only checkpointing, sets status to `awaiting_review` with evidence echoed into STATE, and rejects checkpoints without `--evidence`.

nodes.name: doctor.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for `pactify doctor` — confirms the check passes on a wired+valid repo (including the `mcp server` line) and fails in an empty directory.

nodes.name: f1_branch_flow.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for the F1 branch/commit discipline — `pact_join` creates and checks out the feature branch, `pact_checkpoint` commits the worker's work, and re-join is idempotent (crash-resume).

nodes.name: f3_entry_files.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for F3 entry-file integrity — pact_init must preserve pre-existing content, re-bake must be idempotent, and writes must never leak through a symlinked entry file.

nodes.name: go_schema.bats
nodes.summary: bats test that drives the full Go CLI flow (init→assign→join→checkpoint→accept→merge) and validates the emitted log.jsonl against `schemas/event.schema.json` using jsonschema.

nodes.name: help.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests verifying that pact.sh help output lists every protocol verb and references the two protocol rules (no self-accept, no early merge).

nodes.name: helpers_core.bats
nodes.summary: bats tests for pact.sh helper primitives — `_pact_now` (UTC ISO-8601), `_pact_require_id` (fail-closed on unset PACT_AGENT_ID), and `_pact_log_append` (well-formed JSONL write).
